---
title: "MOUS Group Report"
subtitle: "Cohort-level MEG pipeline summary"
date: last-modified
params:
  summary_json: "derivatives/mous_pipeline/group_summary.json"
---

```{python}
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

summary = json.loads(Path(params["summary_json"]).read_text())
rows = []
for metric, stats in summary.get("metrics", {}).items():
    rec = {"metric": metric}
    rec.update(stats)
    rows.append(rec)
tbl = pd.DataFrame(rows)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

theme_mous <- function(base_size = 13) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1, color = "#0f172a"),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "#64748b", size = base_size - 1, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      axis.title       = element_text(color = "#475569", size = base_size - 1),
      axis.text        = element_text(color = "#64748b"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e2e8f0"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}
```

## Group Summary Table

```{python}
tbl.style.format(precision=4)
```

## Group Means by Metric

```{r}
#| label: fig-group-means
#| fig-cap: "Group-level mean ± SD for each pipeline metric, sorted by mean value."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

df <- as.data.frame(tbl)
if ("mean" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- df[order(df$mean), ]
  df$metric <- factor(df$metric, levels = df$metric)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = metric, y = mean, fill = mean)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#bfdbfe", high = "#1d4ed8") +
    theme_mous() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title    = "Group mean by metric",
      subtitle = "Sorted ascending; colour intensity encodes magnitude",
      x = NULL, y = "Mean"
    )

  if ("sd" %in% names(df)) {
    p <- p + geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
      width = 0.25, color = "#475569", linewidth = 0.6
    )
  }

  print(p)
}
```
